// diagnostic

E0605

Item or field is private to its module (`priv module` or `priv` field)

What

Item or field is private to its module (`priv module` or `priv` field)

Why

A `priv module` is usable only by its enclosing module (`priv(package)`: by its package), and a `priv` field only by its type's module

Fix

Use it from inside its enclosing module, or remove `priv` from the module or field.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0605: tests/ui/marker_group_private_public.stderr.

Error [jet.PrivateItem]: Public marker group `Published` contains private marker `#Internal.Private`
  --> tests/ui/marker_group_private_public.jet:12:18
    |
 12 |         group: #[Internal.Private, Inline]
    |                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A public group cannot publish a module-private marker through expansion
 Fix: Make the member public by removing `priv`, or make the group private
